basics.name: Natalia M. Sikora
basics.label: EPSRC Doctoral Prize Research Fellow, PhD Candidate in Medical AI, Department of Physics
basics.summary: PhD Candidate with a focus on AI-driven outcome prediction in complex systems. Experienced in ML pipelines, explainable AI, multimodal data integration, and signal processing. Published in Nature and AAAI. Strong leadership and communication skills across interdisciplinary domains.

Presented fairness metrics to Mastercard and Turing stakeholders.
